title: Measuring the Impact of Early-2025 AI on Experienced Open-Source Developer Productivity
attributed_claim_summary: METR randomized AI access across 246 tasks completed by 16 experienced maintainers; reported 19% longer task time with early-2025 AI tools.
evidence_or_event: Claims are attributed to the original publisher; no original study results produced here.
limitations: Narrow mature-repository, experienced-developer, 2025-model context; not a universal 2026 or 2027 effect.
research_relevance: AI-era coding methods, independently accepted functionality, OSS reuse and lifecycle cost
practical_experiment: Pre-register total task completion time and accepted functionality; include no-AI baseline.
